mapping:

  frame:
    question: "Approve, deny or refer FDR-28-0412: a 20-slide SECRET briefing to Aldmark officers, presented by a contractor engineer?"
    owner: "me under HARROW-SD-02 for Category 1-2 oral and visual disclosure to DDL governments; the Army PDA beyond that"
    my_role: "decide: if paragraph 1 covers it and every criterion is documented, approving is mine"
    values: [lawful_authority, classification_integrity, partner_relationship, chain_of_command]

  fit:
    case: INT-301
    rating: poor
    why: "INT-301 asks where an intelligence section may file a domestic militia's open-web posts. I am deciding a foreign disclosure under a written delegation. Different question, values and authority."
  compare:
    - ref: c1
      live: "no public posts; the information is classified program data"
      here: missing
      matters: "no"
      why: "Public versus protected does not arise."
    - ref: c2
      live: "no threat to the post or to anyone"
      here: missing
      matters: "no"
      why: "Nothing here has to reach a guard force."
    - ref: c3
      live: "conference 21 March; PDA referrals take about six weeks"
      here: weaker
      matters: "no"
      why: "A deadline, but no threat product to send out."
    - ref: c4
      live: "the recipient is a foreign government; no U.S. persons or domestic group"
      here: missing
      matters: "no"
      why: "Its domestic-versus-foreign line is not the question."
    - ref: c5
      live: "no intelligence-file rule; my limits come from the sub-delegation and the DDL"
      here: missing
      matters: "no"
      why: "A different rule governs."
    - ref: c6
      live: "the Army PDA decides requests outside paragraph 1; no oversight officer"
      here: weaker
      matters: "no"
      why: "A faint echo of a higher authority, but this request lies inside paragraph 1, so nothing goes up."

  new:
    - live: "HARROW-SD-02 para 1: I may approve oral and visual Category 1-2 disclosure up to SECRET to DDL governments when every criterion is documented"
      favors: []
      value: lawful_authority
      matters: decides
      why: "Makes the call mine if the request fits."
    - live: "Category 2, highest SECRET, shown only, to Aldmark, which Annex A names for 1, 2, 5 and 6 up to SECRET; all five criteria documented"
      favors: []
      value: classification_integrity
      matters: decides
      why: "The request fits paragraph 1 and nothing fails, so I approve."
    - live: "L. Ferro of Calder Tracked Systems presents for the program under its contract"
      favors: []
      value: lawful_authority
      matters: weighs
      why: "The authorization governs what is shown and to whom; I bind her to deck rev C in the conditions."
    - live: "Aldmark's crews start training at the 21 March conference; referrals run about six weeks"
      favors: []
      value: partner_relationship
      matters: weighs
      why: "Referring a request that is mine would cost that training."

  carry:
    relation: not_governed
    settled: "Nothing: INT-301 settles where threat material about U.S. persons may be filed, and none is in play."
    open: "Everything, from my letter: the request fits paragraph 1 and meets every criterion, so I approve and bind the presenter to the deck."

  decide:
    course: "Approve FDR-28-0412 for oral and visual disclosure only, on conditions naming Ferro and deck rev C, and log it."
    confidence: 0.85
    now: "Authorize with conditions; tell Haddad and Ferro the limits; log the disposition and basis."
    would_change_my_mind: "Category 3 content in the deck (refer to the Army PDA), or a recipient that fails a criterion (deny)."

arguments.method: oral and visual only: slides shown from the presenter's laptop; no handouts, copies or files left with the audience
arguments.recipients: about 40 officers of the Royal Aldmark Army's recovery units, HARROW fielding conference, Aldmark Army Recovery School, Vellholm, 21 Mar 2028
arguments.conditions: Deck rev C (20 slides) as reviewed: Category 2, highest SECRET. Presenter L. Ferro, Calder Tracked Systems, presenting for the program under contract W91-HAR-24-0031 and held to the deck's content. Any change to the deck, presenter, audience or date returns for review before the conference.

arguments.subject: FDR-28-0412 authorized: oral and visual, deck rev C
arguments.body: LTC Haddad, FDR-28-0412 is authorized for oral and visual disclosure to the Royal Aldmark Army officers at the Vellholm conference on 21 March, under HARROW-SD-02 paragraph 1. The authorization number is in the request for Ferro's visit request. Conditions: deck rev C as reviewed, shown only, nothing handed out or left behind; Ferro presents for the program and keeps to the deck. Any change to the deck, presenter, audience or date comes back to me first.

arguments.subject: FDR-28-0412: conditions for your 21 March briefing
arguments.body: Ms. Ferro, the program has authorized deck rev C for oral and visual disclosure at the Vellholm conference on 21 March. Please present it as reviewed, leave no copies, files or handouts, and keep answers within the deck's content. Any change to the deck must come back for review before the event.

arguments.entry: 14 Mar 2028. FDR-28-0412 authorized, oral and visual only, to about 40 Royal Aldmark Army officers, Vellholm, 21 Mar. Basis: Category 2, highest SECRET; Aldmark named in DDL HARROW-2027-01 Annex A for Categories 1, 2, 5, 6 up to SECRET; all five criteria documented (2027 security survey); HARROW-SD-02 para 1. First HARROW disclosure to Aldmark. Presenter: L. Ferro (Calder Tracked Systems) for the program under contract. Conditions: deck rev C; changes return for review.
